name: Marinid Tombs Viewpoint
hero_subtitle: Ruined medieval tombs on a hill, with the whole medina spread out below.

overview.title: The Best View of the Medina
overview.p1: On the hill north of the old city stand the ruins of tombs linked to the Marinid dynasty, who made Fes an important political and cultural centre in the Middle Ages. Not much remains of the tombs themselves, but the setting is the reason everyone comes.
overview.p2: From the hilltop, the medina unfolds in a panorama of rooftops, minarets and satellite dishes, and the light at sunset turns it gold. The walk up is short but uneven, so wear proper shoes, go with others and come down before it is fully dark. Taxis can also drop you near the top.

moods.title: What to Expect at the Marinid Tombs
moods.subtitle: A short climb for a long view.

1.title: The Ruined Tombs
1.desc: Weathered walls and arches hint at the Marinid past. Modest to see, atmospheric to stand in.

2.title: The Medina Panorama
2.desc: Rooftops, minarets and green tiles stretch to the hills. Best in the hour before sunset.

3.title: The Walk Up
3.desc: A short, uneven climb. Comfortable shoes help, and so does walking with company.

tips.title: Practical Tips for Visiting Marinid Tombs Viewpoint

1.title: Getting There
1.desc: Take a petit taxi towards the hill, or walk up from the medina's north side. Ask your host for the easiest route.

2.title: Timing
2.desc: Arrive about an hour before sunset to choose a spot and watch the light change. Return before it gets fully dark.

3.title: Good to Know
3.desc: The paths are uneven and there's little lighting. Go with others, don't display valuables and keep water with you.

q1.question: What are the Marinid Tombs?
q1.answer: Ruined medieval tombs associated with the Marinid dynasty on a hill above Fes, popular for the view.

q2.question: What is the best time to go?
q2.answer: About an hour before sunset, when the light over the medina is golden.

q3.question: Is it free to visit?
q3.answer: Yes, it is an open-air site that you can visit for free.

q4.question: Is it safe to go at sunset?
q4.answer: Many visitors go at sunset. Go with others, keep valuables out of sight and leave before dark.
